newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Transportadora issues $50 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Transportadora issues $50 mln notes.

text.p: Argentina's Transportadora de Gas del Norte SA said Thursday it has sold $50 million in eight-year floating-rate notes.
Interest on the notes will be at 180-day LIBOR plus 3.125 percentage points. Payments will be made quarterly.
The notes will be amortized in installments of $12.5 million every quarter after five years.
Santander Investment Bank Ltd has underwritten the issue at par.
This is the third issue by Transportadora under its $300 million floating rate note program.
